source: V20 Dark Ages (VtDA20), pp. 188-316. Mechanics as codes and short summaries in WoDX's own words; read the page for the full system.

abyss.ritual: Occult 3+, level capped by Obtenebration or Occult; +1 difficulty without an Occult specialty (p. 270)

powers.e: Senses predators nearby (Cainites, shapeshifters, ghosts, killers) for the scene.
One turn to grow a predator's trait: claws (Strength +1 lethal), a tail, keen senses and the like.
Sinks into a sleep just short of torpor, hidden from senses and Auspex.
Takes on a darkness-born trait for the scene; Rötschreck is +1 difficulty meanwhile.
Becomes a chosen predator animal; the form must be learned in advance.
Speaks with an animal after eye contact; no roll.
Calls animals of a named kind; more successes, more come.
Cows or soothes a creature's Beast; a mortal loses Willpower drive, a vampire can't frenzy for the scene.
Possesses an animal after eye contact; mental Disciplines work through it as successes allow.
Forces their Beast into another after eye contact: frenzy or worse in the target, calm in themself.
Sharpens a sense: its rolls are at −Auspex difficulty. Sudden glare or noise can stun.
Reads a subject's aura: mood, then nature of being (vampire, mage...) with more successes.
Reads impressions from a touched object; older, weaker traces are harder (4 to 9).
Sends or reads thoughts; one success to send, more to read deeper.
Projects the mind out of the body, travelling invisibly; the body lies helpless.
Within a week of losing a Humanity dot, rolls to regain it without experience.
A mystic 'dodge': successes cancel a supernatural attack's successes.
Animal blood nourishes fully; an animal holds blood equal to its health levels.
A night-long rite consecrates a place where violence and frenzy are hard.
Speaks words that strip a listener of their Beast's influence for the scene.
A stationary illusion of one sense, about 7 cubic metres per dot.
An illusion for all senses, still or moving as chosen at creation.
Animates an existing illusion while the vampire concentrates.
An illusion lasts until dismissed.
An illusion one victim believes real: it can hurt them (lethal levels by successes).
Learns a subject's moral weakness or Virtue shortfall.
Mocking a known fear makes the target flee or freeze; vampires test Rötschreck.
Hurls a bolt of infernal flame: aggravated damage.
After Sense the Sin, the target rolls their lowest Virtue (vs the Baali's Willpower) or their derangements erupt.
A lasting curse; successes set its length (a week up to permanent).
Inflames one emotion in the target; successes extend it.
After three turns of talk, the victim is plagued by sights and sounds for nights by successes.
Reads the hidden pattern in a person, court or event.
A stronger Soul Haunting that can drive one or several into madness for the scene.
Strips a target's sanity, granting a temporary derangement.
A one-word command, obeyed at once after eye contact.
Implants a complex instruction; successes set how well it holds.
Removes or rewrites memories; more successes, deeper changes.
Extended: 5 to 10 × the subject's Self-Control/Instinct successes make them pliant.
After a clash of wills (subject rolls Willpower, 7), takes over a mortal's body.
Knows when someone deliberately lies; no roll.
Sees fae and the fae-touched truly, and senses faerie magic.
Absorbs an object's impressions, erasing them as they are learned.
A ward symbol that bars or hurts a named fae, object or person.
Poses a riddle the victim can do nothing but ponder until solved.
A zone of total silence around them, up to 20 feet.
Unnoticed while still and quiet; drawing attention breaks it.
Seen as someone else; copying a real face needs a good look.
Disappears even while watched; contested by the highest Wits + Alertness.
Extends an Obfuscate power to one more person per dot of Stealth.
+1 die to Intimidation and Stealth; shapes nearby shadows.
A 10-foot cloud of utter darkness; those inside fight blind and may falter.
One 6-foot shadow tentacle per success that grapples and crushes.
Shadow images, one per success, or one larger one.
Three turns to become living shadow: immune to most physical harm, can't touch or be touched.
A sacrificial rite seeds an area with slumbering plants that hinder intruders (−2 to all pools).
A sacrificed warrior's head gives them wound immunity and fighting edges for a scene.
A curse laid through the sacrifice of the target's friend or kin.
A wicker-man rite over three nights; a great blessing of war.
A sacrifice on a dolmen opens a draught of power and blood.
Projects one simple impression to everyone around: social rolls helped.
Terrifies a target: cowed, fleeing or frozen by successes.
Bends a subject's emotions: they want to serve the vampire, from hours to months by successes.
Calls someone the vampire has met to come to them, as fast and as willingly as successes allow.
No roll: anyone who would act against them rolls Courage (vs their Charisma + Intimidation) or can't.
Sees in darkness; ignores blind-fighting penalties; eyes glow red.
Claws: Strength +1 aggravated damage.
Sinks into bare earth and rests there, safe from the sun.
Becomes a wolf or bat over three turns (extra blood speeds it).
Becomes mist over three turns; immune to most physical harm.
Drains a victim nearly dry to learn and keep the gist of their knowledge.
Turns blood to poison (up to the per-turn limit); a hit reduces Stamina by successes.
After their blood enters the target, wracks them from afar: lethal damage by successes.
Blood on a blade or claws as poison: aggravated wounds.
After feeding on mortal blood, each success makes a point count double.
Hardens or preserves an object with their blood.
With a point of the target's blood in a vessel, knows when they lie.
A blood baptism that can wash away a blood bond or Dominate.
Imprints an emotion in a subject's blood; whoever drinks it feels it.
Through a drop of the target's vitae, makes them sweat blood points away.
−1 difficulty on Social rolls; a gaze can freeze one target in place.
A forked tongue lash: Strength aggravated damage, an extra attack.
Scaled skin: soak difficulty 5, Stamina soaks aggravated (not fire or sun).
Becomes a great serpent over three turns (blood speeds it).
Births a serpent-beast from their own flesh; a health level stays marked while it lives.
Bargains with an object's spirit for bonus dice on one kind of task.
A spirit animal takes form; successes set how long it stays.
Takes on one animal trait for a turn per success.
Devours a spirit: a Willpower point per success.
Strength +3, Dexterity and Stamina +2; Appearance and Manipulation fall.
Knows the exact time and how long has passed.
Reflexively freezes a moment to think: extra time to plan or defend.
Slows a target's actions; harder against faster beings.
Leaden Movement on several targets (a blood point each).
Extra actions in a turn by successes, ignoring the blood limit.
Reads health, wounds, blood and whether a subject is living or undead.
A touch blocks pain (wound penalties ignored) or puts someone to sleep.
Heals a touched creature: a blood point per lethal level, two per aggravated.
A barrier of force around them and those they shield.
Cleanses a soul of derangement or the Beast's weight; can restore Road.
Like Sense Vitality, but for death and the dead.
Like Gift of Sleep: dulls their own wound penalties or knocks a foe out.
A grasp that burns: aggravated damage per blood point.
Armor 1 per success (up to five), glowing red.
A hand over the heart kills peacefully; costly for their Road.
Senses a person or event that will matter to their fate.
A touched foe is +2 difficulty to strike them for three turns.
Smeared blood makes the victim shunned by all.
An aura in one chamber where violence falters.
Draws out a victim's soul with a breath.
Reshapes their own face and body (a blood point per change).
Reshapes another's flesh after subduing them.
Reshapes bone; as an attack, aggravated damage.
War-form: Physical Attributes +3, Social 0, claws.
Gives a severed part of their body a life of its own.
Gazes into a ball of shadow to scry the Abyss.
Crushing a flame (an aggravated level, a Rötschreck test), sees through darkness.
Draws the Abyss into their flesh after a turn of meditation.
A night-long summoning of a shade from the Abyss.

powers.n: The Third Eye of Abyssal Sight
powers.e: Sees what hides in shadow and darkness.
A contracted Nocturne shows distant places.
Speaks through the darkness to those far away.
